en: Black‑and‑white image showing a crowd of well‑dressed people in early‑20th‑century fashion strolling in a landscaped park around a small, ornate pavilion or colonnade with Gothic arches and a domed roof. The structure stands in front of grand spa‑style buildings, with wooded hills in the background and tree branches framing the view, giving the impression of a fashionable European spa resort scene.
